sourceChecks.note: Nodus's exact live product route and embedded Squarespace product payload identify Shale SKU SEC-F-SHA at USD 625. The page publishes the Grade 2 titanium case and bracelet, 38 x 11.7 x 47 mm geometry, 20 mm lugs, 100 g on the full unsized bracelet, TMI NH38, 41-hour reserve, Nodus-regulated -10/+10 seconds per day, 100 m resistance, screw-down crown, sapphire, BGW9 Grade A lume material, NEM clasp, and quick-release spring bars. Stock is zero and the route offers restock notification, so availability is unavailable rather than in stock; the page does not publish a repeatable lume-performance grade. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

The exact-model hands-on comparison independently confirms a dedicated no-date NH38 with no phantom crown position. It reports fast initial lume charging, brightness, and immediate dark contrast but explicitly disclaims a stopwatch-style lume test; it provides no controlled charge, elapsed-time series, or repeatable grade. Retrieved 2026-08-30 after a narrow Perplexity source-discovery pass.

A second exact-model hands-on review independently identifies the NH38 as a dedicated no-date caliber and reports only that the lume charges quickly. It does not supply a timed decay observation or shared comparison standard, so it corroborates no-date status but cannot close the lume-grade gate. Retrieved 2026-08-30 after a narrow Perplexity source-discovery pass.
